They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

Key job responsibilities

Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.

About The Team

The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic Qualifications

1+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Experience working with Tableau
Experience using very large datasets

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

About the Job:

As the Strategy & Operations Program Manager for Global Technical Enablement (GTE), you will serve as the operational right hand and proxy to the Head of GTE. This is not a general program-management role; your mandate is to build the operating system that runs the organization and keep the business inspection-ready at all times.

Not a layer between the Head and the four team leaders, their direct line is unchanged.

Not the owner of team execution: Architecture, TLDD, Experiences, and TEDO run their own work.

Not an Executive Assistant: no calendar, travel, or expense ownership.

Drive the OKR Lifecycle: Partner with leadership to draft, cascade, and track OKRs, proactively mitigating schedule risks before they impact the business.

Vendor & Platform Lifecycle: Oversee the end-to-end renewals of GTE platforms, manage vendor relationships, and optimize the operational tech stack.

Access & Tech Governance: Manage the integration, provisioning, and access logistics for the org's internal and external enablement platforms, ensuring seamless workflows and security compliance.

Own the "Walking Deck": Maintain a continuously current narrative of the business (org, strategy, OKR status, metrics, risks, and wins) that is ready to present with zero prep.

Turn Data into Narrative: Partner with analysts to convert central dashboards, learner throughput, and course CSAT into the actionable story leadership needs.

Anticipate the Inspection: Prepare the Head of GTE for executive reviews, QBRs, skip-levels, and ad-hoc escalations by running dry-runs, producing briefing docs, and pre-empting leadership questions before they are asked.

Represent the Head: Act as a proxy in forums the Head cannot attend, carrying context in, bringing decisions back, and holding the room at a leadership altitude.

Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the primary strategic coordination bridge between GTE pillar leads and key external partners (Product Management, Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Support).

new_jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, Metrology
new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About The Team

The Reliability team at Relativity Space ensures quality is built into every stage of the Terran R design and production process, embedding reliability from the very beginning. The team works directly with design, manufacturing, test, and launch teams to stay close to the hardware, understand constraints, and proactively shape decisions. As the program moves from development into production and scaled operations, this is the time to establish the right processes, controls, and inspections without slowing progress. The team plays a key role in balancing risk, fostering a culture of ownership, and making sure speed never comes at the cost of reliability. Success means creating a quality system that scales with the Terran R program and Relativity as a whole.

About The Role

Manage all internal and external calibrations of electrical, mechanical, optical, and RF measurement equipment, and oversee calibration of precision test equipment using NIST-traceable standards
Drive multidisciplinary teams including metrology technicians, quality engineers, and operations personnel
Define the long-term calibration strategy and roadmap, including evaluation of bringing calibration capabilities in-house
Ensure vendors maintain compliance with ISO/IEC 17025, ANSI/NCSL Z540.3, AS9100, and NASA requirements
Provide expert technical guidance on metrology and calibration, ensuring integrity and accuracy of measurement data used for critical decision-making
Review calibration certificates and technical documentation, and maintain equipment tracking systems and calibration databases (e.g., Indysoft)

About You

3-5+ years of progressive experience in metrology and calibration, with at least 1-2+ years in a program or project management role, preferably within aerospace, defense, or precision manufacturing
Deep technical knowledge of calibration methods for electrical, mechanical, optical, and RF/microwave measurement equipment, dimensional metrology, and measurement uncertainty analysis and traceability principles
Strong understanding of metrology standards including ISO/IEC 17025, ANSI/NCSL Z540.3, AS9100, and NIST traceability requirements
Proficiency with multimeters, oscilloscopes, pressure/temperature gauges, dimensional tools, and calibration databases. Working with hardware/instrumentation exposed to process gases/fluids.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information to expert and non-expert audiences
Meticulous attention to detail and strong analytical skills

Nice To Haves But Not Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Metrology, or a closely related technical field (or equivalent experience with 7+ years in metrology/calibration)
Experience establishing and scaling calibration programs from the ground up
Self-starter with demonstrated ability to define and own processes and roll them out through effective communication to diverse teams
Familiarity with blueprint and schematic interpretation
ASQ Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) or equivalent certification
Strong knowledge of enterprise applications (PLM, ERP, MES) and proficiency in data analysis tools

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range

$99,500—$149,000 USD

new_jobs.title: ABA Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Program Manager Role

Overview

Program Managers at PBS Corp. are responsible for overseeing and coordinating high quality service delivery, ensuring continuity of care, and supporting the professional growth of their teams. Individuals in this role must demonstrate strong clinical judgment, organizational leadership, and a commitment to PBS Corp.’s standards of excellence.

Required Credentials: Program Managers must hold active state licensure in accordance with local regulatory requirements and/or maintain certification as a Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) or higher. Additional state specific credentials may be required depending on service location.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee program implementation and service delivery for assigned clients.
Coordinate with regional teams to ensure organizational efficiency and client satisfaction.
Maintain high performance standards and ensure compliance with company policies and state regulations.
Manage scheduling, approve time off, and support staffing needs as required.
Ensure all required documentation—including E Sign, post hire documents, and compliance forms—is completed accurately and on time.
Monitor, mentor, and support the professional development of supervisees.
Uphold ethical and clinical standards consistent with licensure and certification requirements.

What We Offer

Flexible Scheduling- Work/Life Balance, Scheduling Tools, Manageable Caseloads
Competitive Pay- Full and Part Time Positions
Quarterly Bonus - 10% of annual salary- (2.5% per quarter)
Paid Time Off (PTO) & Paid Holidays
Career Growth Opportunities
Complimentary CEUs and Annual Conference Bonus
Comprehensive Benefits- Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (Full-time employees)
401(k) with Company Match up to 3%

Professional Standards

Program Managers are expected to uphold the high caliber of service associated with PBS Corp. This includes:

Adhering to all clinical, ethical, and operational standards
Maintaining compliance with state licensure and/or BCaBA certification requirements
Participating in performance reviews and ongoing feedback cycles
Demonstrating leadership, professionalism, and commitment to quality service delivery
